facts.fact: Caren 独自在家、头痛发作，在药柜里翻到 Tylenol；她脑子里反复转的是 Yumi 当面撒谎这件事
facts.anchor: I find the Tylenol behind an almost empty tube of arnica cream

facts.fact: Yumi 不接电话不回短信，Caren 自己解释成她生病易累、白天长时间睡觉
电线杆下那张被撕破的寻人传单上，Autumn 是 Finn 最好的朋友，Caren 因此觉得终于认识她一点
Daniel 开门时笑容慢了半拍才到嘴边，随后请 Caren 进屋
facts.anchor: his smile takes a moment too long to reach his lips

facts.fact: 冰蓝皮质护照夹压着金色 JL，里面一本深蓝美国护照、一本酒红法国护照
facts.anchor: Not a notebook after all, but a passport holder.

facts.fact: Caren 在餐桌前数出家里每人对应六把餐椅，这种过剩让她发晕
facts.anchor: a ratio of six dining chairs for each member of the household

facts.fact: Jo 用一句 Sounds like you know everything 认下 Van 两年前入室行窃、偷了手链
facts.anchor: So he did steal that bracelet.

facts.fact: Caren 直接质问 Jo 是否在派对上给她下药、再把她拖进 Baltimore 那栋房子的地下室
facts.anchor: Did you drug me at your party, Jo?

facts.fact: 章末 Jo 把话头推给 Miguel，让 Caren 自己去问他
facts.anchor: I suggest you ask Miguel. Let him fill you in.
